verbatim_request: Document the complete architecture with diagrams and publishable contracts.

relevant_turns.content: Do you think this would contribute something if I open source the idea?
Make it open for everyone and document the whole architecture.

acceptance_criteria.description: Cover model roles, controller, ledgers, routing, narration, continuity, permissions, recovery, usage, and evaluation.
Validate schemas, Mermaid diagrams, links, and privacy before publication.

constraints.text: Use only public, synthetic, or clean-room evidence in published documentation.
Do not change runtime behavior as part of the documentation task.

decisions.selection: Use a realtime foreground role and one on-demand strong primary role.
decisions.rationale: This preserves low-latency conversation while keeping mutation behind the established coding-agent path.

inspection_findings.summary: Zyra already has canonical chat, a server-owned runtime, event-sourced fleet records, and permission boundaries.
